P2_TIMER_HYBRID.argument: CHALLENGE_SET.md P2: the type-1 readout of any plastic parameter receives a law-dependent ES gradient of the same scale as any law-independent drive (both are n * phi(t) / (K sigma sd r) with phi(0) the maximum at the flip point; linear re-weighting over the 8 components cannot change the ratio), so in expectation the parameter stalls below its flip point before the switch and crosses after it; the discrete regime (sigma small, eta / sigma large) is bounded by the ES signal-to-noise n_c phi(0) / (sqrt(K) sd) <= ~3.7 per block and cannot stage a 5-block timer reliably. The no-switch probe is the missing control that would make this empirical for any subject
P2_TIMER_HYBRID.bearing: supports the s3 four-policy argument extended to plastic genomes, EXCEPT for the noise class (B1), which needs no timer; recommends a no-switch arm as a cheap control for the repair round (descriptive, like newlife)
